name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Drones at Bahrain 15 Nov; US blockade holds
summary: Iran's IRGC claimed drone strikes on a US base in Bahrain on 15 Nov and tanker mine strikes near Hormuz
state: The IRGC said it launched six drones at the Riffa helicopter base in Bahrain early on 15 Nov; Bahrain said it intercepted the munitions and held Iran responsible for drone attacks on 13 and 15 Nov (ABC News). The IRGC also said two tankers hit mines near Hormuz and one sank, a claim not independently confirmed (Anadolu Agency). The US enforces a naval blockade of Iranian ports and talks remain stalled. Attacks between states and on Gulf shipping keep the Alert.
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice for Iran, Bahrain and the Gulf states, which can change at short notice; flights in the region may be disrupted.
rubric_hit: Active strikes between states and attacks on Gulf shipping = Alert

sources.title: ABC News — Iran live updates: Bahrain reports Iranian attack

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
